scope: RLL release residual set: 14 authoritative open tokens after applying closure overrides; draft PR evidence is tracked as IN_FLIGHT and does not mutate authority until merged/reconciled.
invariants: draft_or_CI_PASS != authoritative closure until the governed branch reconciliation is accepted
internal execution cannot satisfy independent-human or physical-device authority
standard CLASS/CAMB agreement != RLL perturbation validation
measured approximation error != validated replacement pipeline
negative or null evidence is preserved

items.contract: Construct joint LCDM/CPL/RLL evidence only after component likelihood gates close and overlapping SN compilations are explicitly non-duplicated.
items.authority_required: versioned multi-probe likelihood components plus covariance/overlap contract
items.minimal_evidence: hashed priors, covariance/overlap policy, identical model likelihood components, sampler stopping criteria, logZ errors
items.promotion_condition: all selected component gates are authoritative and the overlap audit passes
items.falsifier: any duplicated correlated data block, unversioned covariance, or model-specific likelihood asymmetry
items.next_producer: RLL joint-evidence pipeline after dependencies close

items.contract: A genuinely independent executor/reviewer must rerun frozen artifacts and priors; self-repetition is insufficient.
items.minimal_evidence: executor identity/independence declaration, frozen commit/artifact hashes, commands, environment, outputs and discrepancy report
items.promotion_condition: independent replay reproduces or explicitly falsifies the scoped result with auditable receipts
items.falsifier: same-authority rerun presented as independent, mutable inputs, or missing environment provenance

items.contract: Use immutable official DESI DR2 joint/cross-block products or likelihood release and reproduce official LCDM/CPL references before interpreting RLL deltas.
items.minimal_evidence: source URL/DOI, release/version, checksums, covariance, configuration, LCDM/CPL reference reproduction
items.promotion_condition: official products are frozen and baseline reproduction passes without local block-diagonal substitution
items.falsifier: local 13-observable or block-diagonal setup relabeled as official joint/cross-block likelihood
items.next_producer: DESI official source + RLL reproduction gate

items.contract: Execute the governed replay on an actual Android/Termux device; hosted CI is not a substitute.
items.minimal_evidence: device/ABI/runtime metadata, exact commit, command transcript, exit codes, artifact hashes and bounded receipt
items.promotion_condition: physical receipt validates the scoped runtime claim on the intended ABI/device class
items.falsifier: x86_64 hosted CI, emulation, or unverified transcript presented as physical execution

items.contract: Materialize pinned ACT DR6 CMB-only data and the effective historical CAMB source, execute upstream tests and exact upstream reference predicates, then reconcile the token after review.
items.authority_required: pinned ACT upstream + exact CAMB source + GitHub Actions receipt
items.minimal_evidence: 5 upstream tests, ACT and ACT+Planck reference predicates, source/data hashes, effective CAMB SHA/import path
items.promotion_condition: RLL PR #681 is reviewed/accepted and the authoritative token ledger is reconciled to the successful receipt
items.falsifier: reference predicate fails, effective CAMB SHA differs, data/source custody missing, or claim expands to posterior/RLL CMB

items.contract: Materialize/version DES Y6 3x2pt likelihood, scale cuts and nuisance contract; reproduce LCDM S8/Omega_m before any RLL comparison.
items.minimal_evidence: official source/version/checksums, scale cuts, nuisance priors, covariance and baseline reproduction
items.promotion_condition: official baseline reproduction is within predeclared tolerance and provenance is frozen
items.falsifier: derived summary numbers used as substitute for the official likelihood or missing nuisance/covariance policy
items.next_producer: DES official source + RLL reproduction gate

items.contract: Define covariant or explicitly phenomenological RLL perturbation closure before solver implementation.
items.minimal_evidence: definitions for delta_s, theta_s, sound speed, entropy terms, anisotropic stress, Q_mu, gauge/initial conditions and transition regularization with limits and units
items.promotion_condition: closure equations are self-consistent, dimensionally declared, recover specified limits and have executable analytic/limiting tests
items.falsifier: background-only equations, undefined closure variables, gauge ambiguity, singular transition, or post-hoc solver-specific definitions
items.next_producer: RLL theory contract before any CLASS/CAMB RLL code

items.contract: Implement the same accepted RLL perturbation equations independently in CLASS and CAMB only after closure relations pass.
items.authority_required: two independently implemented solver paths using the same frozen theory contract
items.minimal_evidence: C_l, transfer, growth and P(k) comparisons, convergence/margin tests, code provenance and negative cases
items.promotion_condition: both engines implement the frozen equations and agree within predeclared tolerances across declared benchmark points
items.falsifier: shared hidden implementation, mismatched equations, tolerance relaxation, or standard LCDM/CPL agreement relabeled as RLL validation
items.next_producer: independent RLL CLASS and CAMB implementation branches

items.contract: Freeze primary Planck 2018 and SH0ES/Riess 2022 provenance for exact H0 Gaussian values and preserve overlap semantics.
items.minimal_evidence: DOI/source, table/equation locator, exact quoted numeric value with uncertainty, transformation record and overlap declaration
items.promotion_condition: each prior value traces to primary source and overlap with CMB terms is explicitly governed
items.falsifier: secondary citation only, unexplained rounding/transformation, or Planck-derived prior treated as statistically independent of Planck CMB

items.contract: Cross-check r_drag with pinned CLASS/CAMB, quantify the current approximation, then integrate a validated full-Boltzmann route before rerunning formal H0/r_d inference.
items.authority_required: pinned CLASS/CAMB backend evidence plus validated inference integration
items.minimal_evidence: cross-engine r_drag agreement, approximation error, integration policy, cache/grid/direct reproducibility and repeated 6x4 fit receipts
items.promotion_condition: RLL PR #682 is accepted, then the formal H0/r_d path uses the validated Boltzmann route and 24-cell reproduction passes
items.falsifier: cross-engine disagreement, silent approximation substitution, or inference results promoted before replacement path is executed
items.next_producer: RLL PR #682 then full-Boltzmann H0/r_d integration

items.contract: Capture fresh GitHub rulesets, required checks, protected environments, secret-scanning and push-protection settings as receipts.
items.minimal_evidence: timestamped API/settings snapshots or receipts with repository/ruleset IDs and enforced checks
items.promotion_condition: external settings state is captured and compared with the declared workflow/branch governance contract
items.falsifier: repository YAML assumed to prove server-side settings

items.contract: Classify relevant refs append-only until each is classified or explicitly retired by evidence.
items.minimal_evidence: one row per ref with status, lineage, relevance, ahead/behind or retirement reason
items.promotion_condition: registry coverage denominator equals classified plus evidenced-retired refs with no anonymous remainder
items.falsifier: unseen refs excluded from denominator or bulk retirement without evidence

items.contract: Execute UTM-185 on intended physical Termux runtime and capture a bounded receipt.
items.minimal_evidence: device/ABI, source commit, command, input hash, output hash, exit status and runtime receipt
items.promotion_condition: physical UTM-185 execution passes its declared invariant checks
items.falsifier: hosted CI/emulator substituted for the physical runtime claim

items.contract: Train and evaluate UTM-185 against a declared baseline; unit tests do not imply empirical quality.
items.authority_required: versioned dataset, baseline and training/evaluation protocol
items.minimal_evidence: dataset split hashes, baseline, seed policy, metrics, variance/confidence, training logs and held-out evaluation
items.promotion_condition: declared metric improvement or negative result is reproduced under the frozen protocol
items.falsifier: training-set-only metrics, no baseline, cherry-picked seed, or unit-test PASS relabeled as model quality

F_ok: All 14 authoritative open residuals have an explicit execution contract.
Internal, mixed, governance, human and external authorities are separated.
ACT #681 and H0/r_d #682 successful draft evidence is preserved without premature closure.
F_gap: Authoritative RLL ledgers still require governed reconciliation after draft PR acceptance.
External/human/physical authorities cannot be manufactured by this control plane.
F_next: Reconcile #681 and #682 only after review/accepted branch transition.
Execute OPEN_INTERNAL items while collecting external authorities in parallel.
